title: fix(app-shell): the app bar's Edit app pencil hides for system apps and read-only packages (objectui#12615)
body:
Fixes #12615

## What changed

One gate, `useStudioDesignGate` (new, `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useStudioDesignGate.ts`, not exported from the package), now decides every app → Studio "design this" entry the card names:

- the app bar's **Edit app** pencil (`AppHeader`), and with it the app switcher's **Edit APP in Studio** row, which takes the pencil's own target;
- the sidebar ⋯ menu's **Design** entry (`SidebarItemMenu`), for a navigation entry and for a favorite.
- a page's **Edit in studio** pencil (`PageView`, `page-edit-in-studio-button`, objectui#12540), added by the patch round on claim `6214038429`: `useStudioDesignGate(page ? appStudioRoutePath(activeApp, true, { type: 'page', name: pageName }) : null)`. It is asked before the page's not-found return, and a page that does not resolve asks nothing.

An entry is drawn only when both halves hold:

1. the principal half, unchanged: a workspace admin holding the server-reported `manage_metadata` (`useCanAuthorMetadata`, the check objectui#5521's home cover cards use);
2. the new posture half: the package the entry opens is one Studio's package list serves as writable, read through `fetchPackages` / `PkgEntry.writable` (the server's `writable` verdict, ADR-0070 D2). No second derivation of "writable" was written.

Otherwise the entry is **not rendered** (never disabled). That covers a read-only package's app (HotCRM in the card's walk) and the console's own Setup, Studio and Account apps.

The hook takes the Studio path the entry would open (`appStudioRoutePath`'s answer) and reads the package off its first segment (`studioPathPackageId`). Both callers therefore ask the same question: may this principal design what this link opens? `SidebarItemMenu` is only handed a `designPath`, so that path is the one input the two callers share. No host (`UnifiedSidebar`) had to change.

## The PM's hypotheses, measured on `origin/main` `79c1996`

1. **Holds.** `AppHeader` gated the pencil with `isWorkspaceAdmin && canAuthorMetadata` and nothing else. `appStudioRoutePath`'s own doc says "Writability of the target package is NOT checked here". That sentence is still true of that function, which this PR does not touch.
2. **Holds.** `packages-io.ts` is the posture read Studio's own read-only posture uses (`StudioDesignSurface` sets `readOnly` from `list.find(...)?.writable`). It is reused unchanged.
3. **Holds, with no app-id list.** The three system apps' manifests are `scope: 'system'` (objectstack `packages/apps/{setup,studio,account}/src/index.ts`). The server's package-writability predicate returns `false` for those scopes (`READ_ONLY_PACKAGE_SCOPES`), and `parsePackages` leaves `system` / `cloud` packages out of the list. The rule is "listed AND writable", so a kernel package falls out either way. If its row is ever served in the registry's flat shape, the scope sits at top level, the row is not hidden, and its `writable: false` answers instead. Both shapes are pinned.
4. **Cost: there is no existing provider or cache to reuse, so this PR adds none.** Measured: `fetchPackages` is called only by the Studio landing, the Studio design surface and the command palette's `studio` scope. Nothing at shell level holds the list, and `packages-io` documents that it is deliberately not a response cache. The gate costs one `GET /api/v1/packages` per package asked about, and only for a principal who passes the capability half. It reads when the asked package changes (an app switch), never per render. The bar and the sidebar rows mounted with it share that one request through `fetchPackages`' in-flight read (objectui#11797). Pinned: "the bar and the sidebar rows mounted with it share one read" counts one request, and "a principal the capability half refuses never reads the package list" counts zero.
5. **Holds.** Absent, not disabled. Each absence is read after the list has answered, beside a writable control read the same way. The reading also asserts that no element carries the pencil's accessible name.

**No verdict, no entry.** While the list is being read, and when the read fails, the entry is absent. This is the opposite of `useCanAuthorMetadata`'s fail-open, on purpose; the hook's header says why. An unreported capability set comes from a deployment that never reports one, so failing closed there would remove the CTAs for good. This read answers or fails on each visit. A missing shortcut costs one click through Studio's landing. A drawn one on a read-only package is the dead end this card removes.

## Tests

New:
- `AppHeader.editAppFollowsPackagePosture-12615.test.tsx` covers:
  - no pencil and no switcher row for `com.objectstack.setup`;
  - no pencil for a read-only package (`writable: false`);
  - CONTROL: the pencil and the switcher row for a writable base, deep-linked to the same target;
  - no pencil for an unlisted package or for the flat-shape system row;
  - absent while the list is pending, then drawn once it answers;
  - absent after a failed read;
  - the two cost pins above.
- `SidebarItemMenu.designFollowsPackagePosture-12615.test.tsx` covers:
  - no Design for a Setup entry or a read-only package's entry;
  - CONTROL: Design for a writable base's entry;
  - a favorite judged by its own package;
  - the principal half still standing;
  - `studioPathPackageId` round-tripping every route shape `appStudioRoutePath` builds.

Updated harnesses (the entries now wait on a verdict):
- `AppHeader.designInStudioNeedsAuthoring-10899`, `AppHeader.appIdentity-12201`, `AppHeader.appBarLeftGroup-12461`, `AppHeader.centeredSearch-12472`, `AppHeader.pageRouteNoAuthoringHandles-12198`, `SidebarItemMenu-12427`, `SidebarItemMenu.designOpensStudio-12520` and `UnifiedSidebar.favoritesMenu-12427`:
  - each serves its fixture package as writable and lets the verdict settle before it reads.
- In `SidebarItemMenu.designOpensStudio-12520` and `UnifiedSidebar.favoritesMenu-12427`:
  - the designable fixture `app.objectstack.hotcrm` became `com.acme.crm`. HotCRM's package is read-only, and the new tests pin it as such.
- Six AppHeader harnesses now hold one adapter object for the whole file:
  - the shared feeds key on the adapter's identity (`adapterKey`), so a stub that hands out a fresh adapter on every render re-attaches them on every commit;
  - a case that awaits with the bar mounted then never settles. Measured on the old stub: 34,700 commits in 60 s with no new request, and the same hang with the gate stubbed to the identity function, so it is the harness, not the gate;
  - this is plausibly the unexplained hang `AppHeader.pageRouteNoAuthoringHandles-12198` notes ("with both halves mounted in one tree, this harness's render never finished"). That is an observation; it was not re-measured here.

### Results

The table's readings are round 1's, on `f599de6`. The patch round's readings on the final head `fe2aeba` follow the table. Every heavy run went through the shared verify lock, so wall-clock figures come from a shared box.

| Run (repo root) | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the 108 test files that render `AppHeader`, `ConsoleLayout`, `UnifiedSidebar`, `SidebarItemMenu` or `PageView`, or live in `console/home/__tests__` (all of `layout/__tests__` they name, the `console/__tests__` AppContent suites, the `apps/console` shells) | `Test Files 108 passed (108)`, `Tests 802 passed (802)`, lock verdict `command-exit 0` |
| `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` (the dependency closure, so the type-check reads fresh `dist`) | `command-exit 0` |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the second project's `include` is `src/**/*.test.ts(x)`) | `command-exit 0` |
| `pnpm exec eslint` on the 13 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files | exit 0, 0 errors (the 32 warnings are pre-existing lines in `AppHeader.tsx`, `SidebarItemMenu.tsx` and the 10899 test's mock) |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0, one changeset declared |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | `0 new citation(s)`, exit 0 |

**Patch round, on `fe2aeba`:**
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over 110 files (now including the four PageView Edit-in-studio files and `main`'s `AppHeader.homeMark-12605`) → `Test Files 110 passed (110)`, `Tests 822 passed (822)`.
- Closure build 0; `app-shell` type-check 0; eslint on 17 files: 0 errors (35 warnings, all on pre-existing lines); changeset presence 0; line citations 0.
- **PageView ablation, at `1b4e67f`** (byte-identical at `fe2aeba`): `const studioPath = useStudioDesignGate(` was replaced with `const studioPath = ((p: string | null) => p)(` (blob `d7ebfcfdaf1e` → `edb39c825ba6`). Result: `Tests 5 failed | 1 passed (6)`, with the writable CONTROL green. Restore proven.
- `origin/main` was merged three times in all. objectui#12601 and objectui#12605 landed in `AppHeader.tsx` (#12605 also in `AppHeader.appIdentity-12201.test.tsx`); both merged clean and keep both intents.
- `Live E2E (informational)` is red at its backend-start step, as on every PR built on `f62b6ff`. That red is objectui#12649's, not this diff's.

**Ablation, at `690835c`** (the ablated line is unchanged at `fe2aeba`; the hook changed only in doc comments). The run used `node ../objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which replaced `return packages.some((pkg) => pkg.id === packageId && pkg.writable);` in `useStudioDesignGate.ts` with `return true;`, so the posture half was gone. The mutation landed (anchor x1 to x0, blob `0f8d83a07af5` to `06d12c72b15b`). The two new files then went `Tests 7 failed | 9 passed (16)`. Exactly the seven posture cases went red: Setup, the read-only package, the unlisted package and the flat-shape row in the bar; Setup, the read-only package and the read-only favorite in the sidebar. The controls, the pending and failed reads, the cost pins and the principal case stayed green. Restore was proven by blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The predicted direction was red, and red is what was observed.

The rest of `@object-ui/app-shell`'s suite (the package holds well over a thousand test files) was left to CI. That narrowing was a choice, and the list above is what it kept. The list comes from a source grep for those component names, so it cannot see a test that reaches them through another module.

## Acceptance notes

- **Screenshots (card acceptance 2): NOT MEASURED, reason:** the sibling `objectstack` checkout in this container has no install and no build (no `node_modules`, no `packages/*/dist`). Booting a backend for the console takes a full install plus a build of the CLI's closure on a box shared by parallel agents. The seat runs the browser check at review.
- **The fourth door, `PageView`'s Edit in studio pencil, now follows the same gate** (patch round, claim `6214038429`). It is pinned by `PageView.editInStudioFollowsPackagePosture-12615`:
  - no pencil on a Setup, read-only or unlisted package's page;
  - absent while the read is pending and after a failed read;
  - CONTROL: a writable base's page opens `/studio/com.example.my_base/interfaces?surface=page:welcome`.
  `PageView.editInStudioNeedsAuthoring-10899`, `PageView.editInStudioOpensStudio-12540` and `AppHeader.pageRouteNoAuthoringHandles-12198` serve their fixture package as writable and settle before they read.
- Clause-②: no. Nothing new is exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`: the hook is imported by relative path only, and neither the package index nor `hooks/index.ts` re-exports it.
